भगीरथ मेघ or मेघभगीरथ ठक्कुर son of Rāmacandra,
grandson of Jayadeva, brother of Maheśa and Dā-
modara, pupil of Jayadeva Paṇḍita:
 Kiraṇāvalīprakāśavyākhyā.
 Dravyaprakāśikā.
 Nyāyakusumāñjaliprakāśaprakāśikā.
 Nyāyalīlāvatīprakāśavyākhyā.
[]

मयूरचित्रक or मेघमाला or रत्नमाला indication of coming
rain, famine or plenty, etc. from the appearance of
the atmosphere, attributed to Nārada. L. 2668.
Report XXXV. Pheh 8. Quoted in Śāntisāra.

मेघमाला from the Rudrayāmala. Stein 236. Weber
2240.

मेघमाला jy. on the signs of coming clouds and sub-
sequent rain, of meteors and lightning, and the
omens to be derived from their appearance. L. 4222.
Peters. 4, 36. Rgb. 843. 844 (by Garga).

 --Raudrī. IO. 1681.

 --in the form of a dialogue between Śiva and Pārvatī.
Fl. 337. Rgb. 845.
